g.title: t
g.text: 14 tasks in total; all share one feature set (11 features). Labels are computed on each series with thresholds frozen on real train. MLP runs on U2.1 only in profiles min/mid and on all tasks in max.
Every (task, model) is fitted in regime S (TSTR) and R (TRTR) and evaluated on real val and OOT.
